faq.title: Mau uiraʻa e tupu mai hou te haamataraʻa.
faq.description: Mai te mea e aita ā tā ʻoe uiraʻa i pāhono-ʻia i vaho nei, e nehenehe te aparaʻa e tauturu i te faataa i tā ʻoe mau hinaaro.
faq.0.question: Eaha te mau tāvini e nehenehe e hāʻanira e Nocoding?
faq.0.answer: Te hāʻanira nei mātou i te mau tahua tāpura ʻōhipa aore ra CV taʻata, te mau api haamataraʻa aore ra tāpura pāʻoihaʻa, te mau faanahoraʻa ʻite e ʻōhipa, e te ravea aunoa no te ʻōhipa pāʻoihaʻa.
faq.1.question: Eaha te maoro o te hāʻanira?
faq.1.answer: He tāpura ʻōhipa, CV taʻata aore ra api haamataraʻa faufaʻa e 1-3 mahana ʻōhipa i muri i te ineineraʻa o te mau mea. Te mau ʻōhipa rahi aʻe e tiʻaturi i te mau hinaaro, te mau tuʻatiraʻa e te rahi o te mau manaʻo.
faq.2.question: E nehenehe te hoho e te mau ravea e faatītī-ʻia?
faq.2.answer: ʻĀe. E nehenehe te hoho, te faanahoraʻa o te api, te mau ravea e te haereraʻa ʻōhipa e faanaho i tā ʻoe mau hinaaro. E hiʻopoa-pǔpǔ-hia te hoho hou te haamataraʻa o te hāʻanira.
faq.3.question: Eaha te tomo i roto i te moni?
faq.3.answer: Te tomo i roto i te moni te hāʻanira mai te pūʻohu e te rahi i faaau-ʻia. Te Pūʻohu Iti e tomo i te tiaʻiraʻa ʻore moni e te iʻoa tahua i te hoê matahiti, e te Pūʻohu Rahi e tomo i te tiaʻiraʻa ʻore moni e te tāhere tahua i te hoê matahiti.
contact.title: Parau mai i tā ʻoe mau hinaaro tahua. E tauturu mātou i te faanaho i te ara.
contact.description: Tonohia mai te hoê hiʻoraʻa poto o tā ʻoe pāʻoihaʻa, te mau api e hinaaro ʻoe e te taime e tīhia. E tomo i te pāhonoraʻa matamua te mau a-manaʻo no te rahi e te mau ʻaʻano i muri mai. Aita e moni no te aparaʻa, i te taime ato o tā ʻoe e hinaaro.

project.description.astra: He tauturu AI e nehenehe e aparau noa atu ʻoe no te tiaʻi i te mau tauʻa numera, mai te tono i te mau token aore ra te hāʻanira i te mau tauʻa numera, aita e ʻite pāpaʻi porotarama.
project.description.auditfi: He mauhaa hiʻopoa paruru i te AI no te mau porotarama moni numera e ʻimi i te mau vahi paruparu e e papaʻi i te parau haapuraʻa i te mau tāmau-poto.
project.description.p2p: He tahua no te tauiraʻa i te mau tauʻa numera tonu i rotopu i te mau ʻiritiraʻa, e te paruruʻa o te mau ʻutuʻutuʻaraʻa e te vahi faatere no te faatere i te tahua.
project.description.payguppy: He porotarama e tauturu i te mau fare toa ʻaifaito ia fāriʻi i te mau ʻutuʻutuʻaraʻa moni numera na roto i te mau QR code o tā rātou e vai nei.
project.category.tiptap: Porotarama no te mau tahu parau
project.description.tiptap: He tahua no te mau tahu parau e fāriʻi i te mau hōroʻa mai te mau taʻata hiʻo i te moni numera aore ra te mau tauʻa numera, e te mau pūai parau i te taime o te mau faaʻiteraʻa ora.
project.description.senkus: He pehe i nā ʻinitānete i te tumu o te ʻiteraʻa e te alchemy: e tāfaʻi te mau taʻata pehe i te mau rāʻau, e haaputuputu i te mau tauʻa numera e e tauaparau i roto i te ʻāreʻa.
project.category.quickstock: Porotarama tiaʻi i te toe tauʻa
project.description.quickstock: He porotarama komepiuta no te tiaʻi i te toe tauʻa o te hoê fare toa ʻahu: te papaʻiraʻa i te hoʻoraʻa, te mau hōroʻaraʻa a te mau hōroʻa e te mau parau haapuraʻa toe tauʻa, e te rahi e tiʻaturi i te tiʻaraʻa o te taata ʻōhipa tāhi.
project.description.caer: He tahua no te tarahu e te tārahu i te mau tauʻa numera i rotopu i te mau tuʻatiraʻa i te turuʻi i te rupia numera IDRX, e māmā ai te haaputu e te tarahu.

notfound.text: Ua taui paha te tuʻatiraʻa tā ʻoe i tāmahora, aore ra aita ā i ineine. Hoʻi i te api matamua no te hiʻo i tā nocoding_ e pūpū.
article.ctaDefault: Aparaʻa ʻore moni i nā WhatsApp, i te taime ato o tā ʻoe e hinaaro.
wa.contact: Ia ora na Nocoding, e hinaaro vau e aparau no te hoê tahua no tā ʻu pāʻoihaʻa. Parau mai i te mau ʻaʻano i muri mai.
wa.package.0: Ia ora na Nocoding, te hinaaro nei au i te Pūʻohu Iti. Parau mai i te mau ʻaʻano i muri mai.
wa.package.1: Ia ora na Nocoding, te hinaaro nei au i te Pūʻohu Rahi. Parau mai i te mau ʻaʻano i muri mai.
wa.article: Ia ora na Nocoding, ua taioʻ au i te hoê tumu parau i tā ʻoutou tahua e e hinaaro vau i te hoê aparaʻa. Parau mai i te mau ʻaʻano i muri mai.
project.category.ineedsave: Web no te download i te media totiale
project.description.ineedsave: Web ʻōmaha ʻore no te download i te mau video, hōhoʻa e te reo mai te TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X e te tahi atu mau platform. Tāpiri i te link, maʻiti i te quality, e tāpaʻo.
project.category.ineedbarcode: Web no te hāmani i te barcode e te QR code
project.description.ineedbarcode: Hāmani barcode e QR code ʻōmaha ʻore, e 100+ huru barcode. E haʻaputu te mau taʻata faʻaʻohipa i te data, e faʻahuru i te hoʻohoʻa, e download i te PNG ʻia au i te taʻi.
